verdict.rationale: Jira's first-party features page lists "SAML & SSO", which directly names both parts of the story as a product capability. The evidence is only a feature-list heading, with no setup documentation, IdP details or enforcement controls, and no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: configuration docs for SAML/SSO, details on supported identity providers and org-wide enforcement, hands-on or community corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can secure organization access with SSO and SAML
